targets.authors: Wills, H., Kamps, D., Fleming, K., & Hansen, B.
targets.title: Student and teacher outcomes of the class-wide function-related intervention team (CW-FIT) program
targets.evidence_quote: The purpose of this study was to provide a close conceptual replication of the first CWFIT RCT (Wills et al., 2016) by using methods of the original study and following procedures as closely as possible (Cook, 2014; Coyne et al., 2016).
targets.outcome_quote: Effects in this CW-FIT study provided a successful replication for student and teacher outcomes, indicating positive findings and significantly better performance for high-risk students in intervention classes than those in the comparison classrooms (Wills et al., 2016).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly give an overall successful replication verdict for student and teacher outcomes. Smaller Tier-2 improvements are discussed as limitations, with continuing positive effects.
